messages:
maya: Incident detected in EU GPU pool (orbit-3) while rolling 23.4 — pausing the rollout and holding all related deploys. @deploybot please pin prod and stop canary traffic.

deploybot: AUTO: Deploy paused by maya at 1733345566. Canary traffic set to 0%. Prod pinned -> v23.3. Relevant commands: 
```
deploybot pause --release 23.4 --by maya
deploybot pin --env prod --version v23.3
```

dan: quick question — do we want an immediate rollback or pin-and-observe first? :thinking:

sasha: ops telemetry shows increased OOMs on kv-cache shortly after the kernel tweak landed. I'd prefer pin+monitor for 30m and run a staged revert in staging before deciding a full rollback.

leo: customer impact check — three EU customers on high-throughput paths are seeing tail latency spikes. CS alerted and asked us to hold outbound comms until we have a clear path. If SLA breach looks likely we should escalate.

maya: agreed. proposed plan: 1) pin prod to v23.3 (done), 2) stop canary (done), 3) run smoke + kv-cache revert in staging, 4) if errors still present after 30m -> rollback to v23.2 (prepared). I'll update the release ticket and notes.

dan: +1. I'll prepare rollback job but won't execute until we get a thumbs from ops. rollback job id queued: rb-20260320-01

incident-bot: INCIDENT 5491 update: linked ticket https://go/reports/5491 — status: INVESTIGATING. Owner: sasha.

sasha: starting staging revert test now (reverting kernel tweak PR #4821). Will post results in ~10m.

maya: thanks. tagging @eng-oncall for visibility. No more deploys to orbit-3 until we clear. Keep thread for coordination only — move deep debug to the incident ticket.

leo: ack. will monitor metrics and post any customer escalations here.
